notes.title: Pivotal Update: Holly's Character Evolution!
notes.content:
Hey there, amazing community!

Celebrating progress! From concept to creation, witness the transformation of Holly's character in The Chase. Here's a glimpse of evolution of Holly's character in The Chase from our early stages to the latest look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/199af72adb811a200a83688e5ea75dda946d5840.jpg[/img]

We've leveled up Holly's appearance in The Chase! Using Unreal Engine's cutting-edge Metahuman Creator, we've reimagined her with incredible detail and realism. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/8181ba013b1740d27fc877cee1fc4cbf340421f7.jpg[/img]

Our dedicated team skillfully transformed Gourab's original dress design into a game-ready model, ensuring every detail shines in-game. Checkout his Artstation: https://www.artstation.com/gouravdasssh

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/8c29492845c24d2ce3a96d815848eb7d75365ec7.png[/img]

The transition from our previous model to this revamped version marks a milestone in our game's development. Take a closer look at her enhanced character through these screenshots, showcasing the remarkable transformation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/e662781058cef7e723f7a84c26b16e8d036bbb8c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/94b85ecdb7af1b4f6daf2527192a6a85f8b5a888.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/0e85b31cd3a1427e5b233367310d5ed0acd89c2e.jpg[/img]

Now you can join our all new Discord group for further updates
🔗﻿﻿ ︳Join Discord server: https://discord.gg/PGCkrtbmmj

Rest assured, we're dedicated to delivering a top-tier game, and we'll release it when it's ready. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to show you what we've been working on.

Stay tuned for more updates!

Warmest regards,
RAM Studios

notes.title: "The Chase" - Exciting Changes and Progress!
notes.content:
[i]Bound by more than words – an unbreakable emotional connection. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070413/e662781058cef7e723f7a84c26b16e8d036bbb8c.png[/img]

Hey there, amazing community! 
We're thrilled to share an update on the progress of "The Chase." 

Yes, the game is very much under development, and we want to thank you for your patience and unwavering support. We've been through some tough times securing the necessary funds and resources for the project, which has led to a bit of a delay.

But we've got some exciting news to share! 

Here's the big reveal: We've migrated the project from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5, ensuring that you'll experience the best next-gen gameplay. 

In addition, we've revamped the game's narrative, creating a powerful and immersive story. We've crafted all-new character models and animations for cinematics from the ground up, adding a whole new level of realism and immersion. Also more maps, optimizations, and new content have been in the works, all to provide you with an even better gaming experience.

Now you can join our all new Discord group for further updates
🔗﻿﻿ ︳Join Discord server: https://discord.gg/PGCkrtbmmj


Rest assured, we're dedicated to delivering a top-tier game, and we'll release it when it's ready. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to show you what we've been working on. 

Stay tuned for more updates! 

Warmest regards,
RAM Studios
